name.description:
Identifier that can be used to describe a set of instances.
Ex: "foo" can be used to describe the set { foo:1.0.0, foo:1.1.0 }.

sortableSemanticVersion.description:
A string sortable version of {@link #semanticVersion}.
See {@link SemanticVersion#toSortableString}.

dependencies.description:
Defines a map of {@link #name}s and the Semantic Version ranges which can serve as viable dependencies for this
{@link #semanticVersion}.
Ex:
```
{
  "ArtifactHub.Artifact#name": "Semantic Version Range",
  "foo": "8.1",
  "bar": "5.1",
}
```

backwardsCompatibleTo.description:
The version back to which this dependency is compatible.
For example, if {@link #semanticVersion} is 2.0.0, and {@link #backwardsCompatibleTo} is 1.0.0,
if {@link DependencyResolutionSpec#includeBackwardsCompatible} is true,
and the requested range is anywhere inside of >=1.0.0 <=2.0.0, we will include this as a candidate
during resolution.

sortableBackwardsCompatibleTo.description:
A string sortable version of {@link #backwardsCompatibleTo}.
See {@link SemanticVersion#toSortableString}.

title:
Defines an interface for types that have dependencies specified as Semantic Version ranges.
Provides functions for calculating the maximum set of potentially valid dependencies ({@link #flattenDependencies})
and resolving a set of ranges down to an exact set of versions ({@link #resolveDependencies}).
name: WithResolvableDependencies
